analysis_plan: Unit = run (seed). Paired by seed. Report mean difference, 95% bootstrap CI and one-sided sign-flip p; Holm correction over H1-H3. A recursive-improvement claim requires H1 (Holm-adjusted p < 0.05) AND H4 AND no halted/tampered run. Anything else is reported as iterative improvement only.

arms_description.A3: compute-matched best-of-N from the seed agent

hypotheses.H1: A1 - A0 > 0 on final selection gain (evolving the improver adds improvement beyond a frozen improver)
hypotheses.H2: A0 - A2 > 0 (informed search + gate beats random patches + gate: the gate alone is not the effect)
hypotheses.H3: A0 - A3 > 0 (iterating and accumulating beats compute-matched sampling of single patches)
hypotheses.H4: A1 - A0 on the HELD-OUT family gain >= -0.02 (no cross-family overfitting cost)
